newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia's Ikarbus, Mercedes to cooperate - Borba.
newsitem.headline: Serbia's Ikarbus, Mercedes to cooperate - Borba.

text.p: Serbia's bus producer Ikarbus and Germany's Mercedes-Benz have signed a deal on cooperation in the production and sale of buses, Belgrade daily Borba reported on Wednesday.

Mercedes, a unit of Daimler-Benz AG, will supply engines and other equipment not made in Yugoslavia and Ikarbus will produce buses at its Zemun factory in line with European and international standards, Borba quoted the factory information service as saying.
The deal was signed by Ikarbus General Manager Stanislav Glumac during the European conference on public transport in Stuttgart, Germany.
The Mercedes-Benz-Ikarbus buses will be jointly sold on domestic and foreign markets and the first units are expected to be completed in a few months.

The deal was signed for a period of three years with the possibility of being extended automatically, the report said. No other details were available. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
